BL-1100 — The promotion scan disqualifies a candidate by grepping its WHOLE ticket YAML for a hold phrase, so an orthogonality caution, a dependency wait, or a spec step that merely describes the behaviour reads as a human park - three live tickets are silently unpromotable and the auto-pick path drops them without a word
What it solves: Reported by the coordinator as a `note` on 2026-08-23 03:49Z, after it hit the false positive on BL-1071 and promoted that ticket by hand rather than leaving it starved. The report was accurate as sent and needed no correction; the survey of the other 33 matches is this ticket's own.
On the phrase …
Approval context: Firm: prose must never decide promotion. A sentence a human wrote to EXPLAIN an ordering constraint cannot be indistinguishable from one that parks the ticket, and a dropped candidate cannot be silent.
Your call is whether to DELETE the prose check or narrow it, and I have a recommendation. Delete …
BL-1100 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1100" (or "reject BL-1100 <reason>") to act.
